Subject: Your cheque bounce matter

Dear Mr. Rajan,

Thank you for meeting us on 1 June 2021 about your dispute with Ghosh Enterprises. As we understand it, the cheque was returned unpaid for insufficient funds.

Our advice is to send a statutory demand notice to the drawer and file the complaint if the drawer does not pay. Please collect the original dishonoured cheque, the bank return memo and proof that the demand notice was delivered and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of INR 6,10,000/-.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
